crossRefs.note: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will…

I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked…
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
